title: Nutty Chewy Canadian Brisket Pulled
description: A hearty, nutty, and chewy Canadian-inspired slow-cooked beef brisket dish, perfect for a cold winter evening. Serve with gluten-free buns and your favourite toppings.

ingredients.name: Beef Brisket
ingredients.notes: Choice of flat cut or point cut, or a combination of both.

ingredients.name: Flaked Bonito
ingredients.notes: Dried bonito shavings, found in most Asian markets.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Optional, omit if you're watching sodium.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Optional, omit if you're watching sodium.

instructions: Season the beef brisket with salt, black pepper, and your choice of optional spices.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the gluten-free soy sauce over medium heat until fragrant.
Add the grass-fed butter and melt, then add the ground cumin, ground coriander, smoked paprika, and nutmeg.
Add the beef brisket to the pot and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the pot to the oven and braise the beef for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and easily shredded with a fork.
While the brisket is cooking, mix the maple syrup, flaked bonito, and nutritional yeast in a small bowl (if using).
Once the brisket is done, remove it from the pot and shred it with two forks.
Return the shredded brisket to the pot and stir to coat with the braising liquid and nutty maple syrup mixture.
Let the brisket rest for 10 minutes before serving, allowing the juices to redistribute.
Serve the Nutty Chewy Canadian Brisket Pulled on gluten-free buns with your favourite toppings, such as diced onions, pickled carrots, and creamy horseradish sauce.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
Optional: serve with a side of coleslaw or pickles for a refreshing contrast to the rich brisket.
Optional: offer a variety of toppings, such as diced jalapeños, sliced scallions, or crumbled blue cheese, to cater to different tastes.
When serving, consider the presentation: arrange the shredded brisket on the buns in a decorative pattern, or add a sprinkle of chopped fresh herbs for colour and visual appeal.
